diagnostics.title: Three dots instead of ellipsis
diagnostics.message: Use the real ellipsis character ("…") instead of three period characters.
diagnostics.help: Use the real ellipsis character ("…") so UI labels look polished and consistent instead of like three separate periods.

diagnostics.title: Em dash in JSX text
diagnostics.message: Em dash (—) in UI text reads like AI output to your users.
diagnostics.help: Replace em dashes in UI text with commas, colons, semicolons, or parentheses so the copy reads less like AI output.

diagnostics.title: Use dvh instead of vh for full height
diagnostics.message: `100vh` is taller than the visible viewport on mobile (it ignores the browser's dynamic toolbars), so full-height layouts get clipped. Use the dynamic-viewport unit: `h-dvh` / `min-h-dvh` (or `100dvh`).
diagnostics.help: Prefer `dvh` over `vh` for full-height elements. `100vh` overflows under mobile browser chrome; `100dvh` tracks the visible viewport. (`h-dvh`/`min-h-dvh` need Tailwind 3.4+.)

diagnostics.help: Use `rem` for arbitrary font sizes (`text-[0.8125rem]`, not `text-[13px]`) so text scales with the user's root font-size preference. Pixels stay fine for `border-*` / `outline-*`.

diagnostics.title: Deprecated Tailwind v4 utility
diagnostics.message: `flex-shrink-0` is a legacy Tailwind name — use the canonical v4 utility `shrink-0`.
diagnostics.help: Tailwind v4 renamed these utilities: `bg-gradient-*` → `bg-linear-*`, `flex-shrink-*` → `shrink-*`, `flex-grow-*` → `grow-*`, `overflow-ellipsis` → `text-ellipsis`. Use the new names.

diagnostics.title: Tailwind utility is assembled dynamically
diagnostics.message: Tailwind cannot reliably discover this dynamically assembled utility. Write each complete class token as a static string.
diagnostics.help: Use complete, statically discoverable Tailwind utility strings for each state instead of interpolating part of a class token.

diagnostics.title: Low-contrast text in inline style
diagnostics.message: Your users struggle to read this text: its contrast against the background is 4.44:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG minimum, so darken or lighten one of the colors.
diagnostics.help: Text needs a WCAG contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large/bold text) against its background. Darken or lighten one of the colors until it passes.

diagnostics.title: Large inline style object rebuilds every render
diagnostics.message: This inline style has 9 properties, which is hard to read & rebuilds every render. Move it to a CSS class, CSS module, or styled component.
diagnostics.help: Move the styles to a CSS class, CSS module, Tailwind utilities, or a styled component. Big inline objects are hard to read and rebuild on every update.
